games.name: a long hike [Alpha]
games.desc:
Hike with your friends, camp and survive each mile against violent storms, challenges, and enemies.

In 1987, a research team tested a signal known as The Echo Tone, meant to guide wildlife north.
But the sound changed them instead — especially the raccoons. The forest went silent, and the team vanished along a twelve-mile trail. Decades later, the route has reopened. Something still walks it.

Gather your friends and hike twelve miles through shifting forests and violent storms. Build, cook, and survive the nights… but when darkness falls, the hunt begins.

games.name: Stand Power
games.desc:
"Stand Power" is largely inspired by the series "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure".

COMMANDS:
!rejoin -> Allows you to rejoin the same server in-game.
!pity -> Displays your current shiny stand chance pity percentage.
!trade (player name) -> Sends a STAND trade request to the specified player.
!confirm (player name) -> Confirms the TRADE REQUEST that you've sent.
!accept (player name) -> Both parties must enter this command to finalize the trade (this comes after the "!confirm" command).
!giveitem (player name) -> Gives the targeted player the item you're currently holding.

🌐Available on:

・💻 PC
・📱 MOBILE
・🎮 CONSOLE (Note: A keyboard and mouse are required for gameplay)

💻PC Controls:
・F to BLOCK
・L to open INVENTORY
・CTRL to RUN

games.name: Baldi's Basics - Classic
games.desc:
"Oh noes! Your friend left all of his notebooks at school and can't come back to get them because he's too busy! So, you decide to go back into the school to help him out.
But things aren't going to be that easy... You'll have to deal with professor Baldi and the rest of the school staff trying to stop you while you search through the halls and rooms for all the notebooks!

Can you collect them all and escape the schoolhouse?"

This game is an accurate Roblox recreation of classic Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning, based on version 1.4.3 of the original game. I tried my best to remake every bit of the entire game, gameplay, mechanics, and AI just like how they are in the actual game.

The game supports on almost every device, PC, mobile, console, etc. Headphones are recommended.
